message: Book the first flight of the aircraft's day, and leave 65 minutes to connect at ATL
source: Source: BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance, model: the misconnect curve, scheduled flights 2023 to 2026-07, as of 2026-10-01.
sql:
select dep_hour as key, count(*) as flights,
           avg(case when arr_delay < 15 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as on_time_rate,
           avg(arr_delay) as mean_delay
    from wh.fct_flights
    where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null and (year between 2023 and 2026)
    group by 1 order by 1
